interpretations.postholes_building_traces: Recorded posts and building-related traces; source review distinguishes identified houses, inferred functions and isolated posts. Not automatically dwellings or farmers.
interpretations.combustion_features: Deliberate combustion or cooking installations, indoors or outdoors; not a unique domestic, pastoral or ritual activity.
interpretations.pits_occupation_deposits: Pits, explicitly named refuse/storage features and occupation deposits. Generic pits are not assigned a storage function.
interpretations.heated_stone_accumulations: Recorded accumulations of heat-affected stone; mixed activities and secondary deposits possible.
interpretations.clearance_cultivation: Reported clearance and cultivation traces; clearance need not be agricultural and material age need not date field establishment.
interpretations.burial_features: Explicitly named burial forms, including the register definitions of stone settings, mounds and cairns; dates belong to sampled material, not necessarily original monument construction.
interpretations.water_features: Reported wells and waterholes, with fill/reuse dates distinguished from original construction.

phase_omission.purpose: One source-sensitivity omission with two conditional lineage fits of the reviewed older-ground, underlying or probably reworked activity material whose relation to clearance is specifically qualified. Apply to every period, not only the favorable period. This targeted omission is not an estimate of the prevalence of errors in unreviewed sources and is not an independently validated event-date dataset.
phase_omission.reason: Inspect how much the clearance-related component relies on material with the identified event-link uncertainty; preserve both corrected reported-context and omitted-source measurements. No selecting between them on lineage effects.

cohort.interpretation: Sample-defined label units and relatedness blocks, not independently verified pedigrees or representative population frequencies.

design.transformation_policy: Preserve the inherited nonarchaeological controls, first two periods nuisance normalization and first six within-cell score centers. Freeze later-period nuisance normalization and cell centers from source-reviewed measurements and equal total weight per unit before effects. No period-specific PCA normalization. Never recenter within sensitivity/omission subsets.

posterior.extension_rule: Second attempt only for numerical diagnostics; not for effect size or significance.

conditional_mode.starts: Primary: zero; sensitivity: matching primary mode then zero only if required. Retain all failures.

measurement_allocations.interpretation: Allocation-specific conditional modes; empirical ranges are not pooled posterior intervals.

crossed_dependence.weights: Independent Exp(1) factor per246 dependence blocks and per unit-centroid200km cell; multiply, normalize to1335, same block factors across origins.
crossed_dependence.interpretation: Dependence sensitivity; not a calibrated bootstrap posterior or search adjustment.

reviewed_phase_omission.interpretation: Targeted omission of nine reviewed older-ground/reworked activity determinations. LN clearance support drops below primary gate; sensitivity only, no new primary estimand or threshold relaxation.

genetic_omissions.rule: Remove whole units and all their localities. Keep the same frozen design columns/centres/scales. Include B-26258 explicitly.

archaeological_omissions.nomination: Unit-locality weighted whole-site deletion loss averaged equally across 64 draws, 4 periods and 7 families; select 5 sites descending contribution, ties site ID. Select 3 disjoint nearest-neighbour pairs within 10 km by their exact joint deletion loss to the nearest surviving site, ties lexical. No labels or coefficients in nomination. Empty survivor sets have zero proximity within the observed source universe. Recompute replacement nearest sites, recording and all scores; do not refit the basis.
archaeological_omissions.failure: Record any emptied or unsupported draw rather than add sites or change the period.

paternal_location.rule: Inherited uniform-disk displacement using each position draw_seed; pair location draw i with date/archaeological-position draw i; recompute proximity and recording. Keep alternative localities and all transformations.
paternal_location.interpretation: Assumed positional scenarios, not empirical error bounds.

regions.assignment: Reuse inherited verified NUTS2 position assignments and combine SE31/32/33; unit included only if all its localities belong to one block. Preserve existing nearest-polygon-within5km flags.
regions.rule: Restrict whole units in fixed design; retain priors and frozen full-cohort transformations. Report category counts and no estimate when fewer than two categories or no score variation remain.
regions.interpretation: Geographical scope appraisal, not independent replication or automatic significance criterion.

inference.finite_difference_checks: All four primary endpoints and first/last allocation fit per origin: finite-difference directional gradient and Hessian, finite mode and positive curvature. Likelihood/gradient also independently checked in Stan.
inference.claim_limits: Conditional exploratory associations with represented modern origins; historical mechanism, lineage arrival, equality/convergence and a temporal baton handoff are not inferred from coefficients alone.
inference.prior_selection_knowledge: All inherited screen, two-period posterior and sensitivity results are known. The clearance review, later-source review, common-period source support and expanded numerical design precede any new four-period coefficient. This is selected exploratory analysis, not independent replication.

regions.position_rule: Inside one NUTS2 polygon; otherwise nearest polygon within5km for shoreline/generalization only, explicitly flagged. Multiple covering polygons or farther locations unassigned. SE31/32/33 combined. All localities of a unit must belong to one block for a within-block estimate; otherwise retain in national model only.

later.stream_policy: Use original global recording-coordinate displacement streams. The one subsequently added registry coordinate has no inherited stream and uses zero assumed displacement; source uncertainty remains separately recorded.

posterior.diagnostic_extension: One extension to 2000 warmup+2000 retained, adapt_delta=.99,depth14 only for failed numerical diagnostics; no effect-based extensions.

crossed_dependence.weight_rule: Independent unit-mean-centroid cell and genetic-block Exp(1) multipliers; multiply per unit and normalize to sum to unit count. Same multipliers across four profiles; fixed original priors.

conditional_sensitivities.transform_rule: Freeze all profile/control transforms and I1 weights in every fit; omissions remove complete paternal units. No cross-profile coefficient differences.

inference.output_scope: Four sampled conditional posteriors and complete conditional sensitivity summaries. Exploratory representation-conditioned intervals and sensitivity distributions are distinct; no selection-adjusted confirmatory claim. The two preferred profiles may support the main historical comparison; companions and contrary results remain available in the supplement.
inference.prior_selection_knowledge: All inherited effects, representation selection and original sensitivity results were known. Original outcomes are not independent validation; no grid search, reorientation or retuning is authorized.

design.uncertainty: Sampled conditional posteriors and whole-unit dependence sensitivities; no selection adjustment.

normalization.policy: Frozen full-cohort centers and scales from the sequential comparison definitions. The three later-period constants precede the Heda withholding; the common scale is retained when adding the earlier period. Do not re-estimate constants in source-correction or sensitivity arms.

geography.regional_basis: Helmert orthonormal contrasts over sorted locality cells; fixed regional category intercepts with declared priors.
geography.centering: Subtract the frozen cell-specific archaeological centers. Alternative localities can occupy different cells; omit complete units in influence checks.

simulation.aim: Evaluate recovery and conditional interval behaviour for the fixed Migration I1 versus Z284 contrast under shared geography, observation covariates and specified dependence or spatial misspecification.
simulation.prior_knowledge: All Swedish results known. The rounded injected contrast 0.4 is informed by the observed 0.368/0.431 estimates. This is not preregistration before the empirical study.
simulation.fixed_design: Original 200 km regional grid; all 1335 units, alternative localities, 246 block memberships, four exposures and controls fixed. No resampling of sites or additional archaeological selection.
simulation.generating_model: Constrained fit of the existing eight-category locality-mixture model with every archaeological slope fixed to zero; same nuisance priors and regional/recording/opportunity controls. Nuisance estimates fitted once, not drawn from their posterior.
simulation.signal: Add +0.2 Migration slope to each I1 category, -0.2 to Z284, 0 to others; subtract reference-category slope. Weighted I1-Z284 contrast exactly 0.4. Other periods have zero direct archaeological slopes.
simulation.dependence: Gaussian-copula inverse-CDF categorical draws with latent correlation 0.5 within the frozen blocks. Marginal unit probabilities preserved. Category order fixed to the declared order. Block geometry is reused as a stress condition, not claimed to be a generative pedigree model or an empirical dependence estimate.
simulation.curvature: Use standardized squared northing, northing*easting, squared easting; each category receives fixed seeded N(0,0.5^2) coefficients. No archaeological outcomes or exposures enter construction. Reference-category field subtracted. This is an omitted-geography stress test, not a calibrated null test under the fitted likelihood.

methods.full: Frozen regional model, all four cell-centred exposures, 13 controls, same priors and locality likelihood.
methods.simple: Same cell-centred exposures, locality likelihood and priors; retain intercept, linear coordinates, recruitment and terrain, omit regional intercepts and eight period recording/opportunity controls. This is an adjustment ablation, not a claim of superiority over all spatial methods.

simulation.inference: Conditional modes and inverse-Hessian 95% intervals. This evaluates the conditional estimator and approximation, not full posterior repeated-sampling calibration, crossed-weight interval calibration, or the earlier axis-selection procedure.
metrics: Monte Carlo standard errors and Wilson intervals for rates
simulation.limits: Under misspecification, comparison to the injected direct effect diagnoses apparent concordance without that direct effect; it is not proof that the fitted pseudo-true coefficient is zero. Fixed observed recording footprints are retained, not a generative excavation process. Null simulations do not supply an adjusted p-value for the observed selected finding.

chronology.question: When does the frozen four-period comparison add information beyond pooled archaeological geography, correctly distinguish a positive period-specific relationship, or leave chronology unresolved?
chronology.scope: Conditional estimator and declared attribution module on fixed Swedish profiles. Not calibration of the historical axis/source-selection process, full-posterior intervals, dependence ranges or lineage arrival.
chronology.design: Original200km grid only; same1335units,eight categories,locality-mixture likelihood,all nuisance controls,common exposure scale,frozen reference means and priors. Both-grid residual correlations/condition numbers reported as design diagnostics, not extra simulated choices.
chronology.generating_nuisance: Fit the geography/observation-only multinomial model once to the current cohort. Use its parameters for every scenario. Under independent training outcomes sample one category per complete unit after averaging locality probabilities. Independent test outcomes use a separate seed stream at the same observed profiles.
chronology.signal_direction: Full-category logit direction [0.5,0.5,0.5,-0.5,0,0,0,0], subtract category0 for7nonreference coefficients. Thus every I1 category has the same injected difference againstZ284; the fixed composite slope equals the declared truth.
methods: Same geography and observation controls, no focal archaeological slopes
Same nuisance controls plus one pooled posthole-minus-hearth proximity
Same nuisance controls plus all four period-specific proximities
chronology.pooling: Union sites across all four eligible panels separately for postholes/hearths. Apply the nearest-feature maximum within each positional realization before averaging. Use the same common0.1905027224scale; freeze unit-weighted global/regional centering on the reference cohort. Pooling is not the sum of period slopes.
chronology.retained_results: All4focal period estimates,their4x4covariance,all6direct differences,full fitted coefficient modes,numerical diagnostics,exact input/scenario seeds,all failures and retry reasons. Separate coefficient recovery,temporal attribution and common-outcome prediction.
chronology.reporting_rule: From the joint4x4normal approximation construct95%simultaneous intervals for4slopes and6differences using the95th quantile of the maximum absolute standardized10contrasts. Fixed scrambledSobol16384standard-normal4vectors and declared seed; shared covariance is retained. Nominate a uniquely strongest positive period only when its slope and its3differences against all other periods have positive simultaneous lower limits. Otherwise distinguish detected positive relationship/chronology unresolved from no detected positive relationship. Report two-sided any-period false detection separately. Unresolved differences do not establish equivalence.
chronology.support_rule: A unique-period nomination additionally requires at least5distinct sites for each feature in every compared period. Missing support is reported separately as insufficient archaeological support; no data-dependent threshold change.
chronology.prediction: Paired independent categorical test outcomes at the same observed profiles; log score and multicategory Brier score. Also compute expected scores under known generating probabilities to reduce test-outcome MonteCarlo noise. Report calibration by probability-bin discrepancies against known generating probabilities. No geographic transport claim.
chronology.performance: Bias,RMSE,marginal95%interval coverage,simultaneous10contrast coverage where truth exists,correct/wrong unique-period nomination,any-period null detection,chronology-unresolved and insufficient-support rates. Pooled truth has no true period slope; do not fabricate common slope recovery there. Paired score differences and MonteCarlo standard errors/Wilson intervals.400replicates give MCSEabout0.011atp0.05;1000null giveabout0.007.

recording_stress.type: Forward geographically selective recording of a deliberately defined latent feature panel. This is a recording stress, not a reconstruction of true Swedish event dates or a full radiocarbon simulation.
recording_stress.latent_panel: Use source-corrected eligible assertions with posthole/hearth or other mapped contexts and valid laboratory likelihood. Assign each underlying laboratory group to the single window with largest calibrated material-date probability if its95.4%envelope intersects a studied window; ties go to earlier period. These hypothetical latent assignments are simulation truth only, not promoted empirical phase memberships.
recording_stress.dependence: One retention uniform draw per canonical evidence_group; identical laboratory duplicates share assignment and draw. Preserve distinct sites and collapse retained assertions into site-feature-period membership before nonlinear measurement.
recording_stress.retention: Base probabilities by chronological order/posthole,hearth are[81/148,91/134],[101/247,39/120],[63/262,103/469],[41/1098,72/1481]. Other mapped contexts use the mean of their period pair. Add0.7times unit-standardized northing of the evidence-group location to the logit. This is a fixed stress magnitude, not an estimated recording model; resulting retention rates are reported, not tuned to targets.
recording_stress.truth_and_observation: Generate outcomes from latent-panel measurements and the common nuisance coefficients. Fit all3methods using recorded-panel exposure,opportunity and recording controls,keeping normalization constants fixed. Empty feature sets yield proximity0 and are marked insufficient support. Rebuild each realization; never thin outcomes or select favorable realizations.
recording_stress.northing_standardization: Unweighted mean and population standard deviation across connected evidence groups; each group position is the mean of distinct site northings. Explicit implementation clarification before any new simulation outcome.

chronology.numerics: Same finite mode-gradient<1e-5,positive curvature and finite estimates. One retry from zero if initial fit fails; failures retained in denominator. At most8workers,one BLAS thread each. Fixed scenario counts; no adaptive extension based on apparent performance.

first_design.npz.purpose: Frozen generating and fitted design for the original conditional estimator evaluation. The first evaluation predates the final site-geometry correction.

chronology_design.npz.purpose: Frozen design and generating parameters for the original temporal-attribution evaluation; source-derived designs are independently reconstructed.

branch_resolution.question: Does the focal relationship materially depend on retaining only the deepest observed branch representations?
branch_resolution.rule: Count baseline deepest-observed screened branches below each frozen-tree node. For each screened record move its label only upward to the highest ancestor in the same declared8category with at mostKof those descendant branches. K=2and5fixed before effects. Never assign an upstream record to an unobserved descendant. Apply the same deepest-observed nonnested pruning after this mapping,then documented-family merging and original proxy/block logic. Retain all exclusions with reasons.
branch_resolution.estimand: Associations in two coarsened branch representations, not more independent people or a correction guaranteed to remove bias. Each unit weights its distinct reported origins equally. Composite-I1contrast weights,global scales and covariate rules remain frozen.
branch_resolution.geography: Retain known-cell archaeological centers. If new represented cells occur,freeze their centers using equal weighting of all source-screened localities before effects; expand the sum-to-zero regional basis with the same prior. Report new cells and cohort changes.
branch_resolution.fits: Two posterior fits perK,one per existing origin,allcategories/periods/contrasts andcompletecoefficientdraws. Same4chains,diagnosticcriteria and one numerical retry. No search among other cuts. Existing physical/archivebaseline preserved.
branch_resolution.no_admissible_ancestor: If a screened label itself represents more than K baseline leaves, keep that label unchanged before reapplying nonnested pruning. Never descend the tree to force a cap.

appraisal.question: Does the AD400–550 I1–R1a-Z284 posthole-minus-hearth association persist within the existing archaeological coverage and under quadratic geographical adjustment, and how do the influential archaeological omissions affect posterior precision?
appraisal.outcome_knowledge: The archaeological grid, earlier posterior fits, source appraisal and conditional influence results informed this bounded sensitivity analysis.
arms: Source-corrected full cohort, original and shifted grids.
Coverage-defined cohort under the unchanged exp(-2) proximity rule at every alternative locality, both grids.
Full cohort with standardized northing squared, northing by easting and easting squared, all other controls retained, both grids.
Joint Kvarnbacken omission, full cohort and all affected archaeological measurements rebuilt, both grids.
Bobygden omission, full cohort and all affected archaeological measurements rebuilt, both grids.

quality_gate.coverage: Every alternative locality of an included unit has mean posthole and hearth proximity >= exp(-100/50).
quality_gate.interpretation: Pragmatic support/estimability checks fixed before fits, not a power calculation or validation certificate.
quality_gate.shared_cell_definition: Centroid-assigned200km cell with at least5I1 and3Z284 geographically covered units, and strictly positive overlap of their within-cell10th-to90th percentile raw-exposure ranges. Check both frozen origins.

appraisal.quality_disposition: Unchanged support rule fails; restricted-material effects not fitted.
appraisal.normalization: Full reference constants and composite weights retained, including subset fits.
appraisal.posterior: Four chains; same model and numerical criteria. Singleton likelihood vectorized and checked against independent log density and gradient; parallel scheduling changes no statistical assumption.

original_posterior.interpretation: Conditional posterior of the specified selected likelihood and priors; grouping sensitivity is reported separately.
